description: This file defines protocols for audio streaming playback in Swift, including methods for playing and stopping streams, and extends implementations to conform to these protocols.

classes.name: StreamingAudioPlayer
classes.description: Implements the StreamingAudioPlaying protocol, handling streaming audio playback.

classes.name: PCMStreamingAudioPlayer
classes.description: Implements the PCMStreamingAudioPlaying protocol, handling PCM audio streaming playback.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Plays an audio stream asynchronously, returning a StreamingPlaybackResult.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the audio stream and returns an optional Double indicating the current position or status.
